subject: Qualification: Deployment mode & PoC plan for Acme Corp
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
To: Alice Nguyen <alice@acme.com>, Bob Thompson <bob@acme.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 12 Jun 2026 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call recap + next steps: deployment mode & PoC options

Hi Alice / Bob —

Thanks for taking the time this morning. Quick recap and next steps so we have alignment on the PoC scope and deployment mode options. Notes from our discussion: 

- Business goal: evaluate cost/latency and quality trade-offs to choose a deployment mode for Acme's production inference (customer support and search).
- Data concerns: Acme prefers no long-term storage of PII on third-party systems; some data may require region isolation.
- Traffic profile: ~200 requests/minute steady, spike to ~1,200 RPM during business hours, typical prompt length ~120 tokens, expected inference model size ~13B.
- Primary stakeholders: Alice Nguyen (product), Bob Thompson (security), Carol Li (infra).

Deployment modes discussed: 
1) Hosted API — fastest to try (no infra), good for rapid iteration; less control over dedicated capacity/residency.
2) Dedicated capacity — reserved GPU pool (predictable throughput, stronger isolation), good middle ground for data controls and performance.
3) Private (VPC / on-prem) — for strict residency / audit requirements; longer lead time and higher ops overhead.

Proposed short PoC options (pick one):
A) 2-week Hosted API trial using a production-like prompt set (fastest)
B) 2–3 week Dedicated capacity PoC (recommended if you need residency/isolation and predictable throughput)
C) Proof-of-concept on Private deployment (requires infra lead time; estimate 6+ weeks)

Suggested PoC success criteria (attach full spreadsheet):
- Latency: p95 <= 200ms (inference-only)
- Throughput: sustain 200 RPM with ability to handle 1,200 RPM bursts with graceful degradation
- Cost: per-1M-token cost within your TCO target (see attached)
- Output quality: pass baseline eval on 1k labeled prompts (F1/precision thresholds to be defined)

Next steps / asks: 
1) Confirm which PoC option you prefer (Hosted / Dedicated / Private).
2) Share a sanitized sample prompt set and test dataset (or confirm we should use synthetic).
3) Confirm stakeholders and kickoff availability — are you ok to start the PoC week of 2026-06-15?
4) If Dedicated or Private, please share the infra contact and preferred cloud/account to provision.

Attachments: Acme_PoC_Success_Criteria.xlsx (success criteria matrix). I've also attached our pricing tier PDF for reference.

Thanks — happy to adjust.

Ben
Ben Carter
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
ben@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0123

From: Alice Nguyen <alice@acme.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Cc: Bob Thompson <bob@acme.com>, Carol Li <carol.li@acme.com>
Date: Fri, 12 Jun 2026 10:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call recap + next steps: deployment mode & PoC options

Thanks Ben — this is a great summary. Quick answers from our side: 

- We're leaning away from Hosted API for production because of our data residency and compliance constraints. For the PoC, Hosted could work if we can use sanitized data, but ideally we'd evaluate Dedicated capacity since it aligns with our security posture.
- Primary stakeholders: myself (product), Bob (security/compliance), Carol Li (infra, will own provisioning).
- We can share a sanitized 1k-prompt set later today for quality testing. Caveat: some prompts include customer PII which we'll need to mask.

Questions: 
1) If we go Dedicated for the PoC, what is the expected provisioning lead time and what access do you need from our infra team?
2) For SOC2 / security audit items, can you share the checklist and SOC2 report? Bob will want that before any Dedicated provision.

We are tentatively targeting the week of 2026-06-15 for kickoff — please confirm the earliest you can support.

Appreciate the attachments — I'll review the pricing doc and loop back.

—Alice
Alice Nguyen
Director, Product — Acme Corp
alice@acme.com | +1 617-555-0199

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Alice Nguyen <alice@acme.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 12 Jun 2026 11:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call recap + next steps: deployment mode & PoC options

Hi all — pulling in a few technical details that will help planning if you choose Dedicated: 

- Dedicated provisioning: typical lead time is 2–5 business days once we have the cloud account link and an SRE contact. Dedicated pools support autoscaling policies and burst capacity; for your target throughput we'd recommend a 2-node reserved pool (NVIDIA H100 equivalent) with burst headroom.
- Access required: a temporary service account on your project (least privilege) and outbound egress to Redwood control plane (we can do private links for Private deployments).
- Data handling: during the PoC we can configure no persistent logging of prompts/outputs, and we support client-side encryption for payloads. We'll provide our SOC2 report and security checklist; I'll attach the standard questionnaire and the SOC2 redacted report in a follow-up.
- Success criteria: if you want, we can auto-run the 1k prompt eval and produce a quality regression dashboard and latency/cost dashboards in the Redwood Console.

Attaching: Redwood_Pricing_Tier.pdf (pricing tiers) and a short infra checklist.

If Acme confirms Dedicated, Dev/Marissa/Ben can coordinate with Carol for account access and a kickoff on 2026-06-15.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Sr. Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com

From: Alice Nguyen <alice@acme.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Cc: Bob Thompson <bob@acme.com>, Carol Li <carol.li@acme.com>
Date: Fri, 12 Jun 2026 13:15:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call recap + next steps: deployment mode & PoC options

Thanks Marissa. After talking with Bob and Carol, Acme would like to proceed with a Dedicated capacity PoC for 3 weeks (start 2026-06-15). Primary asks before kickoff: 

- Provide SOC2 report and security questionnaire (Bob)
- Provide a short provisioning checklist and the minimum set of IAM permissions Carol will need
- A sandbox/test endpoint and temporary credentials for our infra team to run smoke tests
- We'll share a sanitized 1k prompt set by end of day 2026-06-12 (we'll mask PII)

Success criteria we want tracked:
- p95 latency <= 200ms (measured on our test dataset)
- At-scale throughput for baseline traffic (200 RPM) and graceful handling of 1,200 RPM bursts
- Quality: >= baseline pass rate on 1k prompts (we'll share the pass threshold)

Can you confirm the provisioning ETA (2–5 business days) is still accurate if we start provisioning today? Also confirm who will be the main technical contact at Redwood for the kickoff (name + email).

Best,
Alice

From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
To: Alice Nguyen <alice@acme.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev@redwood.com>, Carol Li <carol.li@acme.com>, Bob Thompson <bob@acme.com>
Date: Fri, 12 Jun 2026 15:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call recap + next steps: deployment mode & PoC options

Perfect — thanks everyone. Confirming plan and owners so we can move quickly: 

1) PoC type: Dedicated capacity (3 weeks) — start provisioning today with target kickoff on 2026-06-15.
Owner: Marissa Cole (marissa@redwood.com) and Dev Patel (dev@redwood.com) for infra/provisioning.

2) Security docs: Marissa will send SOC2 and the security questionnaire by EOD.
Owner: Marissa Cole.

3) Provisioning: Redwood needs a temporary service account + an infra contact (Carol). Estimated provisioning ETA: 2–4 business days once we have access (we'll prioritize to meet your timeline).

4) Test data: Alice will share the sanitized 1k-prompt set by EOD 2026-06-12. Redwood will run baseline evals and surface results in the Console.
Owner: Alice / Acme.

5) Kickoff meeting: Proposed time Monday 2026-06-15 at 10am PT. Invite to follow.
Owner: Ben Carter (scheduling).

I'll attach the kickoff agenda and invite after we confirm the time. Let me know if anything needs adjusting. Looking forward to a smooth PoC.

Thanks,
